with order_items as (

    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_order_items"

),

products as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_products"

),

enriched as (

    select
        oi.order_item_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.product_id,
        p.category,
        p.brand,
        p.weight_kg,
        oi.quantity,
        oi.unit_price,
        oi.discount_pct,
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            as gross_amount,
        oi.quantity
            * oi.unit_price
            * oi.discount_pct
            as discount_amount,
        oi.quantity
            * oi.unit_price
            * (1 - oi.discount_pct)
            as net_amount

    from order_items oi
    left join products p
        on oi.product_id = p.product_id

)

with order_items as (

),

aggregated as (

    select
        order_id,

        count(*) as item_count,
        count(distinct product_id) as distinct_products,
        sum(quantity) as total_quantity,

        sum(gross_amount) as gross_amount,
        sum(discount_amount) as discount_amount,
        sum(net_amount) as net_amount,

        sum(
            weight_kg * quantity
        ) as total_weight_kg

    from order_items

    group by order_id

)

with orders as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_orders"

),

customers as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_customers"

),

order_items as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_intermediate"."int_order_items_aggregated"

),

payments as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_payments"

),

shipments as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_intermediate"."int_shipments_enriched"

),

reviews as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_staging"."stg_reviews"

),

enriched as (

    select
        -- =====================================================
        -- Pedido
        -- =====================================================

        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_at,
        o.order_status,
        o.shipping_type,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Cliente
        -- =====================================================

        c.state as customer_state,
        c.birth_date as customer_birth_date,
        c.created_at as customer_created_at,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Itens
        -- =====================================================

        oi.item_count,
        oi.distinct_products,
        oi.total_quantity,
        oi.gross_amount,
        oi.discount_amount,
        oi.net_amount,
        oi.total_weight_kg,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Pagamento
        -- =====================================================

        p.payment_id,
        p.payment_method,
        p.payment_amount,
        p.installments,
        p.payment_status,
        p.paid_at,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Logística
        -- =====================================================

        s.shipment_id,
        s.shipped_at,
        s.estimated_delivery_at,
        s.delivered_at,
        s.delivery_duration,
        s.is_delayed,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Avaliação
        -- =====================================================

        r.review_id,
        r.rating,
        r.reviewed_at

    from orders o

    left join customers c
        on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

    left join order_items oi
        on o.order_id = oi.order_id

    left join payments p
        on o.order_id = p.order_id

    left join shipments s
        on o.order_id = s.order_id

    left join reviews r
        on o.order_id = r.order_id

)

from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_orders"
where order_status is null

with orders as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_intermediate"."int_orders_enriched"

),

daily as (

    select
        order_at::date as order_date,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Volume
        -- =====================================================

        count(*) as total_orders,

        count(*) filter (
            where order_status <> 'cancelled'
        ) as valid_orders,

        count(*) filter (
            where order_status = 'cancelled'
        ) as cancelled_orders,

        count(distinct customer_id) as total_customers,

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then total_quantity
                else 0
            end
        ) as total_units,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Financeiro
        -- =====================================================

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then gross_amount
                else 0
            end
        ) as gross_amount,

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then discount_amount
                else 0
            end
        ) as discount_amount,

        sum(
            case
                when order_status <> 'cancelled'
                    then net_amount
                else 0
            end
        ) as net_amount,

        -- =====================================================
        -- Experiência / Operação
        -- =====================================================

        count(*) filter (
            where is_delayed = true
        ) as delayed_orders,

        count(*) filter (
            where delivered_at is not null
        ) as delivered_orders,

        count(rating) as reviewed_orders,

        avg(rating) as avg_rating

    from orders

    group by 1

),

final as (

    select
        *,

        
    (
        (net_amount)::numeric
        / nullif((valid_orders), 0)
    )

            as avg_order_value,

        
    (
        (cancelled_orders)::numeric
        / nullif((total_orders), 0)
    )

            as cancellation_rate,

        
    (
        (delayed_orders)::numeric
        / nullif((delivered_orders), 0)
    )

            as delay_rate,

        
    (
        (reviewed_orders)::numeric
        / nullif((total_orders), 0)
    )

            as review_rate

    from daily

)

select *
from final

select
    order_date,
    total_orders,
    valid_orders,
    cancelled_orders

from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"

where
    total_orders <> valid_orders + cancelled_orders

select
    order_date,
    cancellation_rate,
    delay_rate,
    review_rate

from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"

where
       cancellation_rate not between 0 and 1

    or delay_rate not between 0 and 1

    or review_rate not between 0 and 1

select cancelled_orders
from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"
where cancelled_orders is null

from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_orders"
where order_id is not null
group by order_id
having count(*) > 1

select total_customers
from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"

select
    order_date as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"
where order_date is not null
group by order_date
having count(*) > 1

with daily as (

    select *
    from "ecommerce"."analytics_marts"."fct_daily_sales"

),

comparison as (

    select
        order_date,

        net_amount,
        valid_orders,
        avg_order_value,

        cancellation_rate,
        delay_rate,
        avg_rating,

        lag(net_amount) over (
            order by order_date
        ) as previous_net_amount,

        lag(valid_orders) over (
            order by order_date
        ) as previous_valid_orders,

        lag(avg_order_value) over (
            order by order_date
        ) as previous_avg_order_value,

        lag(cancellation_rate) over (
            order by order_date
        ) as previous_cancellation_rate,

        lag(delay_rate) over (
            order by order_date
        ) as previous_delay_rate,

        lag(avg_rating) over (
            order by order_date
        ) as previous_avg_rating

    from daily

),

final as (

    select
        *,

        
    (
        (net_amount - previous_net_amount)::numeric
        / nullif((previous_net_amount), 0)
    )
 as net_sales_change_pct,

        
    (
        (valid_orders - previous_valid_orders)::numeric
        / nullif((previous_valid_orders), 0)
    )
 as orders_change_pct,

        
    (
        (avg_order_value - previous_avg_order_value)::numeric
        / nullif((previous_avg_order_value), 0)
    )
 as avg_order_value_change_pct,

        (cancellation_rate - previous_cancellation_rate) * 100
            as cancellation_rate_change_pp,

        (delay_rate - previous_delay_rate) * 100
            as delay_rate_change_pp,

        avg_rating - previous_avg_rating
            as avg_rating_change

    from comparison

)

select *
from final
